'''Darkelf2000 Jailbreak! (RTP)''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Darkelf2000]]
* '''Published:''' 23 July 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Rescue The Princess|SE-L-rescuetheprincess.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Rescue The Princess
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 RTP Darkelf2000 LS 2003 Jailbrea.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Bust Leia from the pen.. Here's how!

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

First off, I'd like to give credit to Shewski and Revelation, who's RTP decks inspired me to make a deck out of the first objective I ever got in a booster pack, several years ago.  I read it and liked it, but figured it would be a hastle pull it off.  Anyways, onto the strategy :).

Rescuing is fairy easy.  Deploy R2 to Y4:DB, use LTE to pull and deploy a lift tube to DS:DB.  Transit R2, move him in the tube.  Next turn, rescue, drain for 4, move the tube with prisoner over to DS:DB, transit her.  By now, you should have some backup, and drawn some interupts to help protect her.  Turn 3, walk in and flip.

From there, you have several options.  Prisoner Leia Carries a nice drain bonus.  Your EPPs take the fight to the opponent.  Interupts are mostly combat based.  Death star plans can provide great retrieval if done well (i.e. don't let secret plans screw you over).  POTS to lesson opponents drains, or put on the gameboard to add to yours.  Really, i think the interupts in this deck give you alot of options and flexability.  My only concern is the number or characters, and whether i need more for a stable fighting force.  Also, if facing space, not totally sure i can outdrain.

All the sites are pullable, and activation of 9 on my own..  not too terrible, i think.  Effects, and dejerik/holograms also pullable, plus LTE lets you pull out, and put back, your lift tube.

I think this is a decent deck, but also know that theres room for improvement.  Comments please :).

Edit 1: Thanks for reviewing ECF.  Insurrection is to pull my 2 docking bays, give me protection against elis helrot, and the combo saves me from pulling a shield on decks that retreive alot.  I mainly did it because i was worried about my own activation against decks that give me very little.  I have no Council chamber unfortunately :(.  Death star plans might save me from space drains.  Willard i am considering as well as changing leia w/ blaster to antoher prisoner.  Thank you for all the suggestions :).
